integrity: The mathematical proof and finite checker are included without any claim of independent validation. General Gorenstein cutoff is explicitly treated as previously known.
scientific_claim: The reduced singular locus comprises exactly all \(2^{n-2}\binom n2\) torus-invariant \(\mathbb P^1\) edge curves; their only intersections are the torus-fixed points, and every edge cone yields \(\mathbb G_m\) times a rank-one \(2\times(n-2)\) determinantal chart. Generic transverse multiplicity is \(n-2\), and the non-\(\mathbb Q\)-factorial locus equals the singular support.
scientific_limitations: No Jacobian singular scheme or embedded structure at curve intersections is classified.
The full Brennan--Chen (2009) article was not available for inspection; equivalent literature under alternate names remains possible.
Computational tests n=4 through n=7 corroborate, but do not establish, universal quantifiers; those rest on a symbolic integral cone and affine-semigroup proof.
scientific_scope: For every integer \(n\ge4\), over any algebraically closed field, the normal projective toric variety of the even-parity cut polytope of \(C_n\) in its even-sum lattice.
title: Singular rational curves and Segre transversals in cycle cut toric varieties
